skill_name: Summarize the main points of the article "How COVID-19 is reshaping the global economy"
workflow: The article ‘How COVID-19 is reshaping the global economy’ explains that COVID-19 has caused the largest-ever contraction in the global economy, with countries around the world experiencing a significant drop in production, employment, and consumption. In an effort to mitigate the economic effects of the pandemic, governments have pumped trillions of dollars into the economy through stimulus packages, but this is not enough to counter the loss of business revenues.
